## Task 1 · A racing game on a 6 GB phone

A phone has **6 GB** of RAM. The OS uses **2 GB**. The player races in
*Turbo Lane* (**3 GB**, on the screen). In the background wait a chat app
(**0.6 GB**, used 2 minutes ago) and a video app (**0.8 GB**, used 30 minutes
ago).

a) How much RAM is in use (GB)? Is it more than 6 GB (yes / no)?

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) Which app does the OS close first? Write **A**, **B** or **C**.
(A) *Turbo Lane* (B) the chat app (C) the video app

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

c) The player switches to the chat app. What should *Turbo Lane* do? Write
**A**, **B** or **C**. (A) save the race and pause (B) keep the race running
(C) close the chat app

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

## Task 2 · The files of Turbo Lane

The racing game *Turbo Lane* is in `C:\Games\TurboLane`. Sara's save file
`race1.sav` is in `C:\Users\Sara\Documents\TurboLane\Saves`.

a) Write the full path of Sara's save file.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) The team wants to copy one pack of all levels (**one file of 6 GB**) to a
USB stick formatted FAT32. Will it work (yes / no)? Which format would you
choose for the stick: FAT32 or exFAT?
